cp22:1.1: Punāparaṃ yadā homi Indapatte pur' uttame kāmito dayito putto Somanasso ti vissuto, || ||
cp22:2.1: Sīlavā guṇasampanno kalyāṇapaṭibhānavā vuddhāpacāyī hirimā saṅgahesu ca kovido. || ||
cp22:3.1: Tassa rañño patikaro ahosi kuhakatāpaso ārāmaṃ mālāvacchañca ropayitvāna jīvati. || ||
cp22:4.1: Tam-ahaṃ disvāna kuhakaṃ thusarāsiṃ va ataṇḍulaṃ dumaṃ anto va susiraṃ kadaliṃ va asārakaṃ, || ||
cp22:5.1: Natthi' massa sataṃ dhammo sāmaññāpagato ayaṃ hirisukkadhammajahito jīvitavuttikāraṇā. || ||
cp22:6.1: Kupito ahosi paccanto aṭavīhi parantihi taṃ nisedhetuṃ gacchanto anusāsi pitā mamaṃ: || ||
cp22:7.1: Mā pamajji tuvaṃ tāta jaṭilaṃ uggatāpanaṃ yad-icchakaṃ pavattehi sabbakāmadado hi so. || ||
cp22:8.1: Tam-ahaṃ gantvān' upaṭṭhānaṃ idaṃ vacanam-abraviṃ: kacci te gahapati kusalaṃ kiṃ vā te āharīyatu. || ||
cp22:9.1: Tena so kupito āsi kuhako mānanissito: ghātāpemi tuvaṃ ajja raṭṭhā pabbājayāmi vā. || ||
cp22:10.1: Nisedhayitvā paccantaṃ rājā kuhakam-abravī: kacci te bhante khamanīyaṃ sammāno te pavattito.
cp22:11.1: Tassa ācikkhatī pāpo kumāro yathā nāsiyo. || || Tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā āṇāpesi mahīpati:
cp22:12.1: sīsaṃ tatth' eva chinditvā katvāna catukhaṇḍikaṃ rathiyā rathiyaṃ dassetha, sā gati jaṭilahīḷitā. || ||
cp22:13.1: Tattha kāraṇikā gantvā caṇḍā luddā akāruṇā mātu aṅke nisinnassa ākaḍḍhitvā nayanti maṃ. || ||
cp22:14.1: Tes' āhaṃ evam-avacaṃ: bandhataṃ gāḷhabandhanaṃ rañño dassetha maṃ khippaṃ rājakiriyāni atthi me. || ||
cp22:15.1: Te maṃ rañño dassayiṃsu pāpassa pāpasevino disvāna taṃ saññāpesiṃ mamañca vasam-ānayiṃ. || ||
cp22:16.1: So maṃ tattha khamāpesi mahārajjam-adāsi me so' haṃ tamaṃ dālayitvā pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ. || ||
cp22:17.1: Na me dessaṃ mahārajjaṃ kāmabhogo na dessiyo sabbaññutaṃ piyaṃ mayhaṃ tasmā rajjaṃ pariccajin-ti. || ||
